mechanism: Interpret U32 predecessor hints modulo32768 for all PC/PIM chain keys. Keep the original array representation, hash, insertion, search depth, byte validation, route and emitter.
difference_from_old_work: Separates a search-state effect of R13 modular predecessors from their cache footprint. This is a transfer to newly public539, not a new matcher invention. No equality claim: stale or overwritten slots can produce different tested positions.

attribution.ownership: Original539 authors and R13 mechanism attribution retained.
